commands.command:
cd /tmp/llm-ab-_5_gbw43/simplicio-repo && python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re
text = Path("cadastro.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

class P(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.labels=[]; self.ids=set(); self.external=[]; self.scripts=0; self.forms=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        d=dict(attrs)
        if tag=="label": self.labels.append(d.get("for"))
        if d.get("id"): self.ids.add(d["id"])
        if tag=="script": self.scripts+=1
        if tag in ("link","script","img","iframe"):
            src=d.get("src") or d.get("href") or ""
            if re.match(r"^(https?:)?//", src): self.external.append((tag,src))
        if tag=="form": self.forms.append(d.get("id"))
p=P(); p.feed(text)
print("labels for:", p.labels)
print("label targets all resolve to ids:", all(l in p.ids for l in p.labels if l))
print("script tags:", p.scripts)
print("external resources:", p.external)
print("forms:", p.forms)
print("inline-only CSS (no <link>):", "<link" not in text.lower())
assert all(l in p.ids for l in p.labels if l)
assert p.scripts==0 and not p.external and p.forms==["cadastro"]
print("EXTRA-CHECKS: PASS")
PY
echo "EXTRA-EXIT:$?"
